items.name: Barberton Mini 1 2024
items.information:
This competition is taking place on a **Monday** night!

Depending on the number of competitors and the amount of time things take, we may be able to increase the number going to round 2 of each event as well as reduce it if we run short on time. If we manage to run ahead we will try and add a 3rd round of 3x3 but will depend how many register!

Given the nature of the competition everyone **WILL** be expected to help out with judging, running, and scrambling. If you have any questions please ask before registering.
